title: Collector's Notes - How to Earn & Missable Status (Phantom Blade Zero)
description: Collector's Notes trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and rarity once the list is public.
keyword: Collector's Notes phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Game8 lists a different silver in this slot - Unsung Legend, for completing the Enemy Journal - and does not list this one at all. Four other lists carry Collector's Notes with the 30-accessory requirement, so that is the version recorded here. If your list shows Unsung Legend instead, the collectible trophy on your platform is the journal rather than the accessories.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This entry is filled from the shipped game on either platform; PS5 trophy and PC achievement lists are recorded separately where they differ. See the trophy guide for the full list and how long to beat for run-length context.
